risk_note: New H5 entry auth-callback (D10-2716 ②, D10-2717): the Taobao OAuth redirect page, to be served at https://l-stg.couliapp.cn/auth/taobao/callback (staging) and https://l.couliapp.cn/auth/taobao/callback (prod). It reads code and state (each must fully match [A-Za-z0-9_-]{1,256}, decoded once, first value wins), clears the query string with history.replaceState, then location.replace('couli://auth/taobao?code=…&state=…'); on an OAuth error with a valid state it returns couli://auth/taobao?state=…&error=1; anything else stays on a static 请回到凑狸 App 继续 page. Other parameters are dropped. index.html carries <meta name="referrer" content="no-referrer"> before the module script; the page makes no request, writes no storage or cookie, logs nothing and loads no tracker. vite.config.ts ENTRIES gains auth-callback. No API, contract, money or attribution code touched.
